correctness.rationale: Checked actual RESULT.md and nested verification/check.py in pinned tree. Conserved first and second half-step energies force equal interface x=s and opposite velocities ±v; positive-root energy quadratures give ξ=v²/(a√s)=6β(β−1)/(1+β²), with existence exactly 0<ξ<4, β in asserted interval. Scaling exhibits two independent segment-variational solutions X′ and X−3θX′/4; endpoint fundamental matrices have nonzero determinants and their product has det=1, rational trace and M21=−6q(β²−1)/(1+β²) ≠0. Factorizations trace−2=−36(β²−1)²/(1+β²)² and trace+2=−16(β²−2)(2β²−1)/(1+β²)² give spectral regimes. Independent SymPy calculations at rational β=11/10,4/3,3/2,2,3 give exact agreement (β=2 trace=−274/25). The defective Jordan conclusion uses nonzero offdiagonal, not just trace. No nonlinear stability or period-doubling asserted.

value.rationale: A sharp stability-type transition strictly *inside* the periodic-state existence interval is a motivated Floquet invariant: it separates bounded linearized oscillation from exponential instability, with an explicit defective resonance at an exact dimensionless forcing ratio. The proof demonstrates a useful scaling-mode monodromy mechanism.

final_claim: The equal-half-period +a/sqrt(x), −b/sqrt(x) forced oscillator has a unique strictly positive periodic state iff 1<β=b/a<(3+sqrt(17))/2; its determinant-one Floquet monodromy has trace −2(17β⁴−38β²+17)/(1+β²)², crossing elliptic to defective −1 at β=sqrt(2) to real negative hyperbolic.
limitations: Equal step durations and exponent −1/2 only; switch-times prescribed so no saltation matrix; bounded positive solutions; no nonlinear stability, subharmonic branches, or unequal duration.
residual_risks: Other general Floquet monodromy identities for two-step inverse-power oscillators or appendices not indexed may contain equivalent trace, though the nearest Cagnetta source relevant sections were inspected.
